stem: Which one of the following denotes water salinity gradient?
expl: Halocline is a zone in oceanic water in which salinity changes rapidly with depth. So, Halocline denotes water salinity gradient.

stem: Main Source of Salinity of the Sea is –
expl: Main source of the salinity of seawater is the land. While rivers bring various types of salt content to the sea, other factors that regulate the salinity of the sea include vaporization, wind, river water, rain, oceanic currents and volcanoes etc. Average salinity of the sea is about 35‰.

stem: Which one of the following salts contributes maximum to the salinity of sea water :
expl: In 1884, during Challenger expedition, William Dittmar produced a report about the chemistry of sea water. He revealed in the report that there are 47 types of salts present in the sea water among which 7 are most prominent. stem: Where is Great Salt Lake located ?
expl: The Great Salt Lake is located in Utah province of the United States of America. The salinity of this lake is 220‰.

stem: The average salinity of water of Arabian Sea is-
expl: Between 0o-10o latitudes in the Indian Ocean, the salinity is 35.14‰ , but in the Bay of Bengal, it decreases to 30‰. At the same time salinity of the Arabian Sea is found to be 36‰ because of comparatively dry weather, more vaporization takes place and water brought by rivers is also less. Therefore, the nearest option (b) is correct.
